title: Homemade Crunchy Peanut Butter with Jaggery and Ghee
description: A wholesome crunchy peanut butter made from skin-on roasted peanuts, a touch of ghee, and a little jaggery. No refined sugar, no palm oil, no preservatives.

subSteps: Measure 2 small cups raw skin-on peanuts into a plate
Discard any shriveled, discolored or moldy peanuts
Powder 1.5 tbsp jaggery by crushing or grating it fine so it blends without lumps
VALIDATION: Peanuts are plump, uniform and cream-pink with intact skins. Jaggery is a fine powder with no lumps.

ingredients.name: Raw Peanuts
ingredients.notes: skin-on, small cups (about 280 g); sort out any shriveled or moldy ones

ingredients.name: Ghee
ingredients.notes: melted; helps the butter turn smooth and glossy

ingredients.name: Jaggery
ingredients.notes: powdered or finely grated; reduce to 1 tbsp for even less sweet

subSteps: Heat a heavy-bottomed kadai over low-medium heat for 1 minute
Add all the peanuts and stir continuously with a spatula
Roast 10-12 minutes, stirring every 20-30 seconds, so they brown evenly without scorching
Switch off the heat once the skins darken and a nutty aroma fills the kitchen
VALIDATION: Skins are blistered and crackling, peanuts are light golden inside when one is split, with a deep roasted aroma. No black or burnt spots.

steps.instruction: Cool and rub off the skins partly
subSteps: Spread the peanuts on a plate and cool for 10-15 minutes until barely warm
Rub gently between your palms to loosen the loose papery skins and blow them away; keep skins that cling (they hold fibre and antioxidants)
Set aside 1/4 cup of the roasted peanuts and crush them coarsely with a rolling pin for crunch
VALIDATION: Peanuts are warm to the touch, not hot. Most loose skin is gone and the reserved peanuts are broken into rough pieces about 1/4 inch.
Add the remaining warm peanuts and the pinch of rock salt to a dry mixer jar
Pulse 5-6 times, then run on medium speed in bursts of 30-40 seconds, scraping down the sides after each burst
Pause 1 minute between bursts so the motor and the butter do not overheat
Continue 6-8 minutes total: the powder clumps into a thick paste, then loosens into a flowing butter
VALIDATION: Mixture goes from crumbs to a thick ball to a glossy, pourable paste that drips slowly off a spoon. Jar is warm, not hot.
Add 1 tbsp melted ghee and 1.5 tbsp powdered jaggery
Blend 30-40 seconds on medium speed until fully combined
Taste and add a tiny pinch more salt if needed
VALIDATION: Butter is silky and uniform, golden-brown with a gloss. No jaggery specks visible and it tastes mildly sweet, mostly nutty.

steps.instruction: Fold in the crunch and store
subSteps: Transfer the butter to a bowl and let it cool 5 minutes
Fold in the reserved crushed peanuts with a spoon
Pour into a clean, completely dry glass jar and cool to room temperature before closing
Store in a cool place for 2 weeks, or in the fridge for up to 1 month
VALIDATION: Butter is thick and spreadable with visible peanut pieces. It thickens slightly as it cools and holds its shape on a spoon.

seo.metaTitle: Healthy Crunchy Peanut Butter Recipe with Jaggery & Ghee
seo.metaDescription: Make healthy crunchy peanut butter at home with skin-on roasted peanuts, a spoon of ghee and a little jaggery. No refined sugar or palm oil. Ready in 40 min.
